title: Conflict Resolution
summary: Conflict is normal; what matters is handling it fairly. Focus on the issue rather than attacking the person, take breaks when heated, and look for solutions both can live with.
do: Take a time-out if voices rise
dont: Name-call, threaten or use silent treatment as punishment
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
